cohort: The study included patients undergoing frozen blastocyst embryo transfer in medicated endometrial preparation cycles, categorized into groups based on previous delivery mode (nulliparous, previous vaginal delivery, previous CS with or without a niche).
finding: The study found no significant difference in the frequency of uterine contractility between patients with or without a previous C-section or a sonographic diagnosed niche.
mod_finding: The study compared uterine contractility frequency between patients with a previous C-section (with or without a niche) to nulliparous patients and those with a previous vaginal delivery, finding no significant differences.
